## Groundwater

```{r}
#| label: setup-groundwater
#| include: false
if (file.exists("_quarto.yml")) here::i_am("tasks/groundwater/charts/index.qmd")
if (!exists("aoi")) {
  source(here::here("core/R/setup.R"))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: data-loading-groundwater
#| include: false
gwsa_file <- list.files(tabular_dir, pattern = "gwsa_aquifers.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
sws_file <- list.files(tabular_dir, pattern = "sws_aquifers.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

gwsa <- tryCatch({
  if (length(gwsa_file) == 0) stop("No GWSA file found")
  read_csv(gwsa_file[1], col_types = "ccdd") %>%
    select(date = 2, gwsa = 3) %>%
    mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
    arrange(date) %>%
    mutate(
      gap = c(0, diff(date)) > 120,
      group = cumsum(gap)
    )
}, error = function(e) { message("GWSA not available: ", e$message); NULL })

sws <- tryCatch({
  if (length(sws_file) == 0) stop("No SWS file found")
  read_csv(sws_file[1], col_types = "ccdd") %>%
    select(date = 2, sws = 3) %>%
    mutate(date = as.Date(date))
}, error = function(e) { message("SWS not available: ", e$message); NULL })
```

```{r}
#| label: groundwater-flood
#| results: asis

if (is.null(gwsa) || nrow(gwsa) == 0) print_text(paste_bold("No groundwater storage data available")) else {

  gwsa_plot <- ggplot(gwsa, aes(x = date, y = gwsa)) +
    geom_line(aes(group = group), alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", span = 0.2, se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.6, linetype = 2) +
    scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
    labs(title = "Groundwater Storage Anomaly",
         subtitle = "Baseline is the average from April 2002 to September 2023",
         y = "Storage anomaly (mm)", x = "Year") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.line = element_line(linewidth = .5, color = "black"),
          axis.title.x = element_blank())

  ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", "groundwater-timeseries.png"), device = "png",
        width = 5, height = 4.6, units = "in", dpi = "print")

  if (!is.null(sws) && nrow(sws) > 0) {
    aquifer_name <- gsub(".*aquifers_(.+)\\.csv$", "\\1", basename(gwsa_file[1]))

    combined_plot <- ggplot(gwsa, aes(x = date, y = gwsa)) +
      geom_line(aes(group = group, color = "Groundwater Storage"), alpha = 0.6) +
      geom_line(data = sws, aes(y = sws, color = "Surface Water Storage"), alpha = 0.6) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("Groundwater Storage" = "steelblue",
                                     "Surface Water Storage" = "darkred")) +
      scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 years", date_labels = "%Y") +
      labs(title = "Water Storage Anomaly",
           subtitle = paste0(aquifer_name, " (GRACE/GRACE-FO)"),
           y = "Storage anomaly (mm)", x = "Year", color = NULL) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, color = "black"),
            plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
            legend.position = "bottom")

    print(combined_plot)
  cat("\n\n")

    ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", "groundwater-surfacewater-timeseries.png"), device = "png",
          width = 5, height = 4.6, units = "in", dpi = "print")
  } else {
    print(gwsa_plot)
  cat("\n\n")
  }

}
```
